jobs.prompt: r34l1sm, A single continuous shot from a static locked-off camera, no zoom, no cuts. A bright cozy living room in warm late-afternoon sunlight; on the cream wall hangs a framed watercolor portrait of a red Doberman. The real red Doberman with cropped ears and a red collar sits on the rug with his back to the camera, staring up at the painting of himself. He tilts his head to one side, then the other, ears twitching, curious and puzzled, then slowly lowers into a playful crouch, front legs forward and hindquarters up, ready to pounce. The painting on the wall stays perfectly still. Quiet room tone, a soft curious whine, collar tags jingling.
